excerpt:
Shall the City of Omaha be authorized to issue
and sell general obligation bonds in the amount of
one hundred fifty-five million and no/100 dollars
($155,000,000) for the purpose of providing funds
for payment of the cost of acquiring, constructing,
improving, equipping and rehabilitating police
buildings and facilities, fire stations, branch
libraries, park maintenance facilities, auditorium
support facilities, arena and convention center
facilities, public works storage facilities and city
wide building renovations and replacements
and other public facilities of the City of Omaha,
the approximate cost to the taxpayers of the
City of Omaha if this proposal is approved to be
one hundred fifty-five million and no/100 dollars
($155,000,000) plus interest payable on said
bonds to be paid from the fund for principal and
interest payments on the indebtedness of the City
of Omaha as proposed in the notice of election
which also provides that the approval of this bond
issue will not incur any increases in the debt
services tax levy rate of the City of Omaha over
the levy increase approved in 2020?

excerpt:
A vote “YES” in favor of the Proposition will
authorize the City of Valley to allocate up to 50%
of City sales tax revenue for the construction and
related costs of a new municipal swimming pool
and aquatic facility, while maintaining the City’s
current plan to replace all critical water mains in
four years.

A vote “NO” opposed to the Proposition will
require all of the local sales and use tax to
continue to be allocated to water improvement
and wastewater improvement projects.

Shall the City Council of the City of Valley,
Nebraska, be authorized to allocate up to fifty
percent (50%) of the revenue the City collects
from its one and one-half percent (1.5%) local
sales and use tax, on and after January 1,
2027, for the purpose of planning, designing,
constructing, equipping, financing, and
maintaining a new municipal swimming pool
and related aquatic facilities?
